LLM Evaluation.snippet: Sample: built a nightly replay harness that scored the support bot against labeled questions.
LLM Evaluation.bullet: Created an \textbf{LLM evaluation} harness in Python that replayed 1,200 labeled support questions every night, flagging answer regressions before each release and raising grounded accuracy from 81 to 92 percent.

MLflow.snippet: Sample: logged every training run and compared experiments before release.
MLflow.bullet: Logged every PyTorch training run in \textbf{MLflow} with parameters, metrics, and artifacts, letting three teammates reproduce a ranking model in minutes and compare 40 experiments before each weekly release.

Redis.snippet: Sample: cached frequent retrieval results in front of the question answering endpoint.
Redis.bullet: Cached frequent retrieval results in \textbf{Redis} behind a FastAPI gateway, trimming p95 latency of the question answering endpoint from 2.4 seconds to 0.9 seconds at a peak of 300 requests per minute during weekday hours.
